hypothesis: A low point-in-time Household Equity Share identifies periods with higher expected U.S. equity returns and can therefore use frozen V11's otherwise idle risk budget more selectively than an availability-matched unconditional U.S.-equity completion control, without leverage or changing V11's own signal path.

literature_basis.paper: Yang and Zhang, The Household Equity Share and Expected Market Returns / Be Fearful When Households Are Greedy
literature_basis.economic_direction: higher Household Equity Share predicts lower future aggregate U.S. equity excess returns; this trial therefore defines low HEShare as risk-on

allowed_changes: F-HESHARE-US-COMPLETION uses only same-quarter archived Federal Reserve Z.1 first-release Household Equity Share observations that become available at release_date + 1 calendar day
the stable signal regime begins at 2016Q3 because a pre-performance vintage-continuity audit found six >=2 percentage-point first-release/backcast discontinuities through 2016Q2 and none afterward
risk-on iff the latest stable-regime HEShare is <= the expanding median of all earlier stable-regime HEShare observations available by the V11 signal date

on factor-available frozen V11 trade events with 0 < gross < 100% and positive Nasdaq/S&P exposure, allocate all unused gross pro rata only across the currently positive Nasdaq/S&P target weights, leaving non-U.S. weights unchanged and capping total gross at exactly 100%
selection_metric: No within-family selection. Evaluate the single frozen candidate against frozen V11 and C-HESHARE-US-ALWAYS. Primary incremental inference uses the preregistered 2017-01-01+ common window because the point-in-time HEShare definition was frozen as stable only after 2016Q2; full-history product metrics are still reported for disclosure.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: at least 4/5 fixed post-stable folds candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe
deterministic: target gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative target weights
bootstrap on 2017+ common window: paired circular moving blocks, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260822
PBO: not applicable because the family contains exactly one candidate

global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using all prior 31 formal return-seeking candidates plus F-HESHARE-US-COMPLETION, total trial count 32; DSR retains the established full-history candidate-return convention and is supplementary to the 2017+ incremental gates
ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap, and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: This Household Equity Share campaign contains exactly one retrospective candidate. After formal performance is viewed, do not change the 2016Q3 stable-regime start, the 2017 evaluation start, the expanding-median rule, sign, fixed/rolling thresholds, q/q or y/y transforms, z-scores, household-asset definition, release lag, U.S.-asset split, completion fraction, gross target, event scope, or matched control; do not open a second retrospective HEShare rescue family. A suggestive non-robust result may only enter a separately preregistered prospective shadow from a new freeze date without changing this historical rule.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_household_equity_share_v1.py -> tools/household_equity_share_v1.swiftpart + tools/household_equity_share_v1_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: V11-CONTROL full-history metrics and frozen target fingerprint
C-HESHARE-US-ALWAYS availability-matched completion-control full-history and 2017+ metrics
source/eligible/available/completed event counts and portfolio constraints
factor-library archival with truthful lifecycle after the formal result: robust pass may advance under the library lifecycle rules; failure remains rejected research evidence
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 result artifact manifest

factor_definition.source: Federal Reserve Financial Accounts Z.1 original quarterly release archives
factor_definition.stable_start_reason: pre-performance first-release vintage audit; last >=2 percentage-point continuity break was 2016Q2
factor_definition.paper_definition: household equity assets / (household equity assets + household credit assets)
factor_definition.construction: direct corporate equities + household mutual-fund shares allocated to fund equity holdings, divided by that equity amount plus debt securities, loans, and household mutual-fund shares allocated to bond holdings, all from the same archived Z.1 release
factor_definition.risk_on_rule: latest stable-regime HEShare <= prior-only expanding median, excluding the latest observation from the median

strategy_action.eligible_event: a genuine frozen V11 trade event whose current target has 0<gross<1 and positive Nasdaq and/or S&P 500 weight
strategy_action.risk_on_action: fill all unused gross to exactly 100% only through currently positive Nasdaq/S&P 500 weights, pro rata to those U.S. weights; do not change gold or China weights
strategy_action.risk_off_or_unavailable: use frozen V11 event target unchanged

matched_control.rule: on every HEShare-available eligible frozen V11 event, apply the identical U.S.-only completion-to-100%-gross action regardless of HEShare state

shared_rules.event_scope: unique execution dates on which frozen V11 report.trades is non-empty

forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter, source, or target-path change
any stable-regime start-date change after performance is viewed
any full-sample, fixed, rolling, percentile, z-score, rank, slope, acceleration, q/q or y/y HEShare threshold search
any alternative household/fund asset definition or post-result data reconstruction
any release-lag or point-in-time availability relaxation
any 25%, 50%, 75% or other partial unused-gross fill search
any completion above 100% gross or financed exposure
any post-result Nasdaq/S&P allocation-weight search or addition of gold/China to the completion sleeve
factor-driven trades between frozen V11 event dates
candidate replacement or a second retrospective HEShare candidate after results
dropping failed prior formal candidates from cumulative DSR accounting

statistical_audit.global_dsr_return_window: full history for consistency with prior post-protocol DSR accounting

factor_library_archival.action_after_formal_result: archive the factor definition, preregistration, formal result and evidence in FlyingrtxFast with the truthful lifecycle status
factor_library_archival.robust_pass_policy: may advance only according to the factor-library lifecycle and protocol gates
factor_library_archival.fail_policy: archive as rejected research evidence; never hide the failed trial
